human_data.miti.casaa.gold: 20 transcripts (18 clean): the only human MITI-coded spoken data we hold

not_mappable: Q open/closed is not split in MITI
notes: CASAA is too small to train on and is the reference standard, so it is never used for training or tuning.

training_options.A (recommended): MISC-trained model + MISC->MITI mapping (no MITI training data needed)
training_options.B: welivita.gold (MITI-derived, written forum; all folds) -> CASAA: cross-domain, weak labels
training_options.C (if obtained): MI-TAGS (MITI 4.2, 242 sessions) after dedup against HLQC, AnnoMI and CASAA
